stories.headline: Credit Unions Ask Fed to Freeze Debit Interchange Plan Until Courts Rule
stories.body: America’s Credit Unions has called on the Federal Reserve to withdraw its 2023 proposed Regulation II changes to debit interchange until legal challenges have been resolved. stories.headline: Citi's investment roadmap raises eyebrows on Wall Street
stories.body: The global bank said it's ready to take advantage of opportunities to accelerate investments into its business, with an eye toward achieving longer-term, sustainable growth. Analysts had tough questions about the plans.
